scope: CORRECTION: 1649370 has exactly FIVE snapshot content blocks, each with a single call site - the '14 sections' figure from cols does not apply to this build
the_evidence: a scan of the whole .text section for calls to each of those five addresses found EXACTLY ONE call site per block
and all five sites lie inside the same dispatcher, between 0x4723DD and 0x4724A0
so the snapshot format in this build has five content blocks, not fourteen
the fourteen-section figure comes from cols (3.3.3.3) and is a different generation of the protocol
what_that_rules_out: the 'baseline needs all 14 sections' theory cannot be applied directly to 1649370
and our bodies already supply data for all five blocks that exist (the tail after the playerState block feeds actors, 0x471560 and glass)
so the section set is not the blocker either
where_that_leaves_the_loading_screen: the entity pipeline is exercised and accepted (count 1, id 4048, floats written)
the flags byte is correct in both forms (8 and 12 both fail to dismiss the loader)
so the remaining blocker is the FRONTEND's map-load completion, which is a resource/initialisation path rather than a snapshot-content path
and the loader object at [0x8269774] is the handle to that path - it never goes away because the client's own load task never finishes

what_is_proven: the snapshot header format, byte for byte, from the cols writer
the five content blocks and their entry points
the entity list layout (gates, byte count, three-part id) and a working id-control recipe
the entity delta pipeline (changed bit, mode selector, 13-mode jump table, mode 3/4 accumulators, mode 1 commit) and a demonstrated write of real floats into the entity struct
that state 10 can be held while an entity is present, if an entity-free snapshot is sent first
what_is_not_proven: that the client ever renders the world - a screenshot at state 10 with an entity still shows a black frame with a loading spinner
the_honest_position.why_the_work_stopped_here: the remaining condition is inside the client's map-load completion; every snapshot-side lever tried (flags byte, section set, entity content, state ordering) has been tested and none dismisses the loader
